description: Suggest a liquidation unit price in cents from MSRP, condition, category, and lot size. No sign-in required. original_retail is MSRP per unit in cents. Larger lots suggest a lower per-unit price. The result is bounded below retail. This does not change any listing's price.

category.description: Catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

original_retail.description: MSRP per unit in cents. 5000 means $50.00. Required, and must be greater than zero.

quantity.description: Units in the lot. Larger lots get a lower per-unit suggestion. Omit for a small lot.

name: get_pricing_recommendation
title: Get pricing recommendation
